mainEntity.name: How many PDFs can I merge at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed limit. Very large jobs, like hundreds of scanned pages, depend on how much memory your device has.
No. The files are read and combined in your browser, so nothing is sent to our servers.

mainEntity.name: Can I merge only some pages of a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Open the file in the list and click the pages you want to leave out. They are skipped in the merged file.
No. Pages are copied as they are, without recompressing images or turning text into pictures.

mainEntity.name: Why did a blank page appear in my merged PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: You turned on double-sided printing. A blank page is added after any file with an odd number of pages, so the next file starts on a new sheet.
